{{Quote|Waste removal, standby|A Lanupa security guard talking to Lanupa waste removal|<ref name="SC 105" />}}
During the [[New Republic Era]], a '''human''' worked as a security guard at [[Skull Ridge Mountain Hotel & Spa]] on the [[planet]] of [[Lanupa]]. Around [[9 ABY]], he was with the [[Unidentified Lanupa hotelier|hotel director]] when she welcomed [[Jod Na Nawood]] and a [[Skeleton Crew|group]] of [[youngling]]s who were posing as "Wise Elders" from the [[Bratric system]]. Later during the groups visit they were killed by [[Brutus]]'s [[Silvo's pirates|pirates]] in the tunnels under the spa. 

==Biography==
He was [[human]] security guard for the [[Skull Ridge Mountain Hotel & Spa]] on the [[planet]] of [[Lanupa]].<ref name="SC 105" /> Around [[9 ABY]],<ref name="SCDate">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> he<ref name="SC 105 AD" /> watched the ''[[Onyx Cinder]]'' touch down on at the spa. When the [[Unidentified Lanupa hotelier|hotel director]] noticed the junky state of the ship she asked the guard to contact waste removal expecting that the ''Onyx Cinder'' might cause a situation which he did via his [[comlink]]. 

Later that [[Standard day|day]] he was part of a group of guards searching the tunnels under the spa for the ''Onyx Cinder'' crew. He noticed a smooth patch of ground near a stone pillar ahead of him and decided to toss a rock towards it before proceeding. Bars of light activate on the pillar which accelerates the rock upwards. Inching forward the guard sees that the rock was accelerated into a spike trap that had already claimed a skeleton. When he turned around to his team he was shot by the [[pirate]] [[First Mate]] [[Gunter]] causing him to fall backwards into the spike trap.<ref name="SC 105" />

==Personality and traits==
He was a human with short [[Color|brown]] [[hair]], a short brown beard, green [[eye]]s and light skin.<ref name="SC 105" />

==Equipment==
While working at the spa, he wore a [[Color|green]] [[Clothing|uniform]] with a white [[helmet]], white [[belt]] and white [[glove]]s.<ref name="SC 105" />

==Behind the scenes==
The guard appeared in ''[[You Have a Lot to Learn About Pirates]]'', a ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'' episode that premiered on [[December 25]], [[2024]] and was portrayed by [[Ben Rameaka]].<ref name="SC 105" />
